id: CULVER - secondary held-out domain-shift evaluation of the frozen MINT v3.2 comparison set on OPV2V Culver City
label: unseen town, simulated sensor
label_long: OPV2V Culver City: simulated (CARLA) 64-beam LiDAR, the same sensor model as the OPV2V test; a digital town modelled on the layout of the real city of Culver City; unseen during detector training and during all MINT development. NOT real-sensor data.
written: 2026-10-26, before any Culver City data byte was downloaded (only the archive's central directory - member names and sizes - was read, to write this plan)
decision: D-72 (planning/decision_log_proposed_appendix.md; proposed, the user's instruction in chat 2026-10-26)
role: SECONDARY held-out domain-shift evaluation. The OPV2V test (runs/20261024-E5v3, preregistration_v3_2.json) stays the primary, one-time final test. Culver City results are reported separately and never pooled with the test.

data.share: https://ucla.app.box.com/v/UCLA-MobilityLab-OPV2V (same public share as the test archive f_1621736219709 used in Stage 1 / E5; no registration or licence click-through)
data.frames_note: frames = ego-CAV yaml count per scenario from the central directory (OpenCOOD len(dataset)); agents per frame may be fewer than the CAV count (OpenCOOD communication range)
data.written_to_disk: .pcd and .yaml only (camera .png never written), one scenario at a time, raw deleted after both cache files are re-read

checkpoint.readme_row: OpenCOOD README 'Results on OPV2V LiDAR-track': Attentive Fusion, PointPillar, Intermediate, Default Towns 0.815/0.810, Culver City 0.735/0.731 (AP@0.7, no compression / compression); we use the no-compression model
checkpoint.trained_on: config.yaml root_dir opv2v_data_dumping/train (validate_dir .../test); Culver City is a separate test-only split (OPV2V), not in train
checkpoint.published_ap_definition: OpenCOOD frame-order AP (global_sort_detections=False; 'OPV2V paper does not perform the global sort')

frozen_code.frozen_sha256: the full frozen_sha256 list of preregistration_v3_2.json (39 files incl. latest.pth) and the OpenCOOD commit 31ba16025da27ffe4e336f011290dfbc66f9a1f1 (clean tree); verified before any network access and again after the run (v3_stream.verify_frozen, unchanged)
frozen_code.new_files_rule: new files only; no frozen file edited. Per-scenario processing = the frozen v3.1 run_scenario with the v3.2 (D-71) v3_extra, installed by v3_2_stream.install(); stream/ledger/resume logic = a copy of v3_stream.main with the Culver URL, allowlist, member prefix and byte budget. The sha256 of the new files is recorded in runs/20261026-CULVER/code_freeze.json and committed before the first Culver data byte is downloaded.

conditions.note: exactly the v3.2 test conditions; D-70 r = 1.0 levels keep their label 'strong-attack level, added after seeing block-H development results'

parameters_reused_unchanged.pgd: 10 steps, step eps/4, random start, no-GT pseudo-labels, exact stealth projection, infeasible frames not applied (D-68 am. 2), seeds V3PGD|family|r|scenario|frame
parameters_reused_unchanged.reason: same checkpoint and same simulated sensor, so sigma_k (feature scale) and tau_k (clean H magnitude ratio) are not recomputed; nothing is fitted or tuned on Culver City

metrics.AP: AP@0.7 (and 0.5 in tables) under both D-64 definitions: global ranking (headline, D-69) and OpenCOOD frame order (OPV2V-comparable)
metrics.bootstrap: as v3.2: seed 0, 2000 resamples, scenario (whole scenarios) and 10-frame blocks within scenario; one-sided p = (k+1)/(B+1); Holm co-test of B-RAY and R1 vs no defense per AP definition, alpha 0.05
metrics.analysis_code: frozen e5_analyze (test-mode functions) and v3_analyze.run_test, called by runners/culver_analyze.py with the completeness constants set to 4 scenarios / 550 frames and the output label 'CULVER CITY (held-out domain shift)'; no statistic, method or bootstrap changed
reported: mean dAP@0.7 over the 4 original families (both AP defs, scenario + 10-frame CI)
a comparison table OPV2V test vs Culver City for the headline numbers, kept separate

success_rule.rule: the v3.2 rule unchanged: B-RAY Holm-rejected in the co-test with R1 vs no defense on the scenario bootstrap AND B-RAY clean relative loss scenario-CI high <= 1%, evaluated per AP definition; pass under both = 'success'; disagreement = 'AP-definition-dependent'
success_rule.status: reported DESCRIPTIVELY for this secondary evaluation together with the Holm results; it does not change or re-open the OPV2V test verdict
success_rule.coarse_ci_note: 4 scenarios only: the scenario bootstrap has at most 35 distinct resamples (multisets of 4 from 4), so scenario CIs and p-values are coarse; 10-frame CIs are reported next to them but are not the pre-registered primary CI
success_rule.agent_strata_note: frames have n <= 3; per-agent-count strata have 2 scenarios each, so only 10-frame CIs exist there (frozen MIN_SCEN_FOR_SCEN_BOOT = 5)

sanity_check.what: clean no-defense AP@0.7 (OpenCOOD inference path and default frame-order AP) on the first Culver scenario (2021_09_03_09_32_17) right after its download, before any MINT method or attack runs on Culver City
sanity_check.rule: expected in the vicinity of the published 0.735 (one scenario varies: OPV2V test per-scenario 0.72-0.97); if < 0.6 STOP and investigate (coordinate convention, config) before continuing

expected_outcomes.stated: 2026-10-26, from the OPV2V test results (runs/20261024-E5v3/report/report.md) only, before any Culver City number
expected_outcomes.clean_detector: no-defense frame-order AP@0.7 over the 4 scenarios within about +-0.05 of 0.735 (lower than the test's 0.822); global-ranking AP higher than frame-order, as on the test (0.886 vs 0.822)
expected_outcomes.headline_mean4: same signs as the test: global AP R1 > B-RAY >= 0, both below 1 AP point (test +0.45 / +0.15); frame-order AP B-RAY > R1 (test +0.76 / +0.19); R1 - B-RAY AP-definition-dependent as on the test; wider CIs, so the v2 rule may fail under one or both definitions by lack of power
expected_outcomes.clean_cost: B-RAY relative loss below 1% (point); R1 clean cost under frame-order AP positive (test 0.62%) and near zero or negative under global AP; R1-noREMOVE near 0
expected_outcomes.domain_shift: more detector false positives in an unseen town may give B-RAY more boxes to remove; whether that helps or hurts clean AP is not predicted
expected_outcomes.B-NORM: catch ~100% on plain PGD; <= 5% on stealth PGD; clean false-flag rate and AP cost at least as large as on the test (tau_k fitted on default-town block H), so B-NORM clean cost likely several AP points
expected_outcomes.PGD: B-RAY recovery ~0 on every PGD condition; R1 recovery on pgd_remove_stealth@r1.0 around 0.5 (test 0.56) and > 0 on the r = 0.25 remove families under global AP
expected_outcomes.spoof_blind: no defense recovers it (identifiability limit), as on the test
expected_outcomes.fewer_agents: Culver frames have n <= 3 (test up to 5), so per-agent-count comparisons cover n = 2, 3 only

procedural.before_stream: verify the v3.2 frozen sha256 list and OpenCOOD commit; refuse on mismatch; allowlist = the 4 Culver scenarios; only the Culver archive URL; byte budget 7e9 checked before the first data byte
procedural.interrupted_download: a ledger entry not 'complete' -> STOP and ask the user
procedural.resume: re-run the same command; scenarios with both cache files are skipped; a complete extraction marker is reused without a second download
procedural.no_peeking: no AP or criterion is looked at on partial results (except the pre-registered first-scenario clean detector sanity check)
procedural.after_analysis: 4 scenarios and 550 frames asserted (STOP if not)

estimated_runtime_h.basis: OPV2V test v3.2 stream: 2066 frames in 110,809 s (30.8 h) of per-scenario processing (sum of the run.log 'processed' lines), 54 s per frame on average at 1-5 agents; 25-90 s per frame per scenario
